I think the problem here is that the object g doesn't match BOMT21$geno[[1]]$data as the former is genotypes for all chromosomes and the latter is just chromosome 1.

So you'd need to do something like:

for(i in 1:nrow(wh)) {
    g <- BOMT21$geno[[1]]$data
tozero<- !is.na(g[wh[i,1],]) & !is.na(g[wh[i,2],]) &g[wh[i,1],] != g[wh[i,2],]

BOMT21$geno[[1]]$data[wh[i,1],tozero] <- NA
}

But looking at your output from the previous post, it seems that the two pairs of individuals actually have identical genotypes, and so this shouldn't do anything.

Also note that the two pairs of individuals are essentially homozygous for one of the two founder alleles...they look just like one of the founder lines.

karl
